resolution_criterion: Between 3 Jan 2027 and 30 Sep 2027, score each element as present or absent: (a) repeated withholding of appropriated funds; (b) appeals of court orders on spending or related administration action; (c) rewritten executive orders or funding conditions after a block; (d) a negotiated partial funding deal (a statute or continuing resolution that is neither a full clean grant of the Democratic agenda nor a total White House win).
